message:
feat: IA redesign — Home front door, plain names, Lab quarantine

The site had six lore-named modules mixing real tools with simulated
theater, and no explanation of what anything does. Restructured:

- HOME (new default): says what the site is in one sentence, one card
  per real tool with an honest Live / Needs-key badge (from the new
  /api/status booleans endpoint), a how-to line, and one clear CTA
- Nav renamed to plain words: HOME / OUTPOSTS / DEBATE / STUDIO / LAB
- DEBATE: MechaRun stripped to the one real thing it does — the fake
  SaaS pricing tab and gBrain lore removed; crew renamed to plain
  roles (Plans it / Researches it / Attacks it / Decides it); labeled
  example transcript when the Grok key isn't set
- STUDIO: plain-language masthead (hooks + threads with Grok)
- LAB: App Swarm, Carapax, and Agent Factory concept demos kept but
  wrapped behind a persistent 'Concept demo — nothing real runs here'
  banner with a sub-switcher
